items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: They don’t seem to have spent time with Robin Kelley’s beautiful book on Thelonious.

ctx.x: Yes. Do you think it’s harder for young musicians to find something new to present, to find a style that hasn’t already been done. We’ve had a hundred years or so of jazz and it’s been through so many iterations. Like what’s a young player supposed to do now to stand out from the crowd?

Well they certainly don’t go back to “Muggles” by Louis Armstrong. They love Amy Winehouse, maybe somebody — Abbey Lincoln can capture an audience but a lot of the people from the past, I mean Charlie Parker as few peers in jazz but so many of the people coming in right now are not really aware. They don’t seem to have spent time with Robin Kelley’s beautiful book on Thelonious. When I mention a lady called Nica Koenigswarter Rothschild, who I was a waiter in New York and I waited a special table

on her. I learned never to put ice in her glass. I don’t know if they know what I’m talking about. But there are so many things they know that I don’t. I know Oliva, who’s, Olive is working with Biden to get people vaccinations. So I try to keep up with trends but —
